info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Lifecycle Management API
info.description: The Party Lifecycle Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update the lifecycle of party entities within the banking system. Through this API, users can modify various attributes related to parties, such as their status or details, reflecting changes in business circumstances. Typical consumers include banking operation teams and systems that require real-time lifecycle information for accurate customer service and reporting. This API is crucial for maintaining up-to-date data on parties, ensuring compliance, and enhancing the overall customer experience.

patch.description: This operation allows for updating the lifecycle management information of a party identified by PARTY-600045. It enables the modification of various attributes related to the party's lifecycle, ensuring accurate and up-to-date information is maintained.
